segments.thag3.10:1.1: “Ahu tuyhaṃ pure saddhā, sā te ajja na vijjati;
segments.thag3.10:1.3: Yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhamevetaṃ, natthi duccaritaṃ mama.
segments.thag3.10:2.1: “Aniccā hi calā saddā, evaṃ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā;
segments.thag3.10:2.3: Rajjantipi virajjanti, tattha kiṃ jiyyate muni.
segments.thag3.10:3.1: “Paccati munino bhattaṃ, thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule;
